description: If you’re in Baldwin County, Alabama, this is a great chance to meet AshLeigh in a casual setting. She’ll be at the Baldwin County Fair from 5-7 pm CST. Come learn more about her campaign, grab a sign for your yard, and find out how you can help us win on November 3 !
